attributes.background:
Restore the right to live, work, and study across Europe.
Reduce border delays for travellers and businesses. Long passport queues have caused many people to miss flights, while Brexit has increased costs and bureaucracy for exporters and importers.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petitions, which call for similar action:

Start negotiations now to Rejoin the EU

Hold a rejoin EU referendum now
